description: View layer: five new Blade view files plus six targeted modifications to existing nav, admin layout, and all four tutor sidebar views. Depends on FEAT-001 (controllers and route names must exist before views reference them).
steps: Create resources/views/pages/library/ directory. Create resources/views/pages/library/index.blade.php. Use @include('partials.nav') and @include('partials.footer'). Hero section: dark bg, title 'Library — Learning Resources', icon fa-book-open-reader, subtitle 'PDFs, videos, notes, past papers and articles from Kenya's top tutors'. Filter bar: GET form with inputs for category (select $categories), type (select from resource_type labels: Article/PDF/Video/Notes/Past Paper), grade (text), search (text), plus Reset link to route('library.index'). Two-column layout (1fr 300px at 1024px). Left: card grid (2col at 640px). Each card shows thumbnail or emoji placeholder, resource type badge with icon (pdf=fa-file-pdf coral, video=fa-video blue, notes=fa-sticky-note gold, past_paper=fa-file-alt mint, article=fa-newspaper ink), title, excerpt, author avatar+name+date, download count badge (if >0), and a CTA button: 'Read' for articles (→library.show), 'Download' for other types (→library.show which links to library.download). Pagination with withQueryString(). Right sidebar: Categories list with counts, Resource Types quick-filter links, and the Examiner Clinic CTA card (same as blog sidebar). Empty state with fa-book-open icon.

Create resources/views/pages/library/show.blade.php. Use @include('partials.nav') and @include('partials.footer'). Two-column layout matching blog show (1fr 300px). Left: back link → route('library.index'), resource type badge, title, author meta row (avatar, name, date). If resource_type !== 'article': render a download card — file info box (type icon, file size formatted, grade level if set), then a prominent 'Download Resource' button wrapped in @auth (→route('library.download',$resource->slug)) / @else ('Sign in to download' link → route('login')). If resource_type === 'article': render content with {!! nl2br(e($resource->content)) !!} using existing .prose CSS. Share button (same as blog). Right sidebar: 'Related Resources' list (→route('library.show',$r->slug)), 'Need 1-on-1 help?' CTA (same as blog show sidebar). All route references use library.* not blog.*.

Create resources/views/pages/tutor/library/ directory. Create resources/views/pages/tutor/library/index.blade.php. Copy the FULL sidebar+layout structure from resources/views/pages/tutor/group-sessions/index.blade.php (all inline CSS, the layout div, sidebar, topbar, content area). Set page-title to 'My Library'. Add a new 'Content' sb-section in the sidebar between 'Group Classes' and 'Examiner': two sb-items for 'My Library' (route tutor.library.index, active class on this page) and 'Upload Resource' (route tutor.library.create). Stats row (3 cards): Total Resources (BlogPost count for this tutor), Published count, Total Downloads (sum of download_count). Table with columns: Title (with resource_type badge), Category, Grade Level, Date, Status (Published/Draft badge), Actions (View button → route('library.show',$post->slug) target=_blank, Delete form with @csrf @method('DELETE') → route('tutor.library.destroy',$post)). 'Upload Resource' button in topbar. Empty state if no resources.

Create resources/views/pages/tutor/library/create.blade.php. Same full sidebar+layout as index. Page title 'Upload Resource'. Back link → route('tutor.library.index'). Form: method=POST action={{ route('tutor.library.store') }} enctype=multipart/form-data. Add Alpine x-data="{ type: 'article' }" to the form element. Fields in order: Title (text required), Resource Type (select, bind to x-model='type', options from RESOURCE_TYPES with labels Article/PDF/Video/Notes/Past Paper), Category (select from $categories, optional), Subject (select from $subjects, optional), Grade Level (text, placeholder 'e.g. Form 3 / Grade 8'), Excerpt (text, optional). Content textarea: x-show="type==='article'" — rows 8, label 'Content (Article Body)'. File input: x-show="type!=='article'" — accept='.pdf,.mp4,.doc,.docx,.pptx,.png,.jpg,.jpeg,.zip', label shows 'Upload File (max 50 MB)'. Thumbnail image input (always shown, optional). Submit button 'Upload Resource', Cancel link → route('tutor.library.index').

Create resources/views/pages/admin/library.blade.php extending layouts.admin. @section('title','Library'). Stats row: Total, Published, Pending Approval (is_approved=false count), Total Downloads. Filter form (GET to route admin.library): category select, resource_type select, status select (all/published/drafts/pending). Table: Title+excerpt snippet, Type badge, Author name, Category, Grade, Date, Status badges (Published/Draft green/amber + Approved/Pending blue/gold), Actions — View (→route library.show target=_blank), Approve button (POST → route admin.library.approve, shown only if !is_approved), Publish/Unpublish toggle (POST → route admin.library.toggle), Delete (POST → route admin.library.destroy with @method DELETE and confirm). 'New Resource' button opens a modal (same pattern as admin/blog.blade.php modal): fields title, resource_type, blog_category_id, subject_id, grade_level, excerpt, content (shown for article), file (shown for non-article), thumbnail, is_published checkbox. Form action POST /admin/library. Below the table: 'Manage Categories' card — list of BlogCategories (name, description, icon, delete form); 'Add Category' mini-form with name/description/icon fields, POST → route admin.library.categories.store.

Modify resources/views/partials/nav.blade.php. In the desktop links @foreach array (line ~51), replace ['blog.index', 'fa-newspaper', 'Blog'] with ['library.index', 'fa-book-open-reader', 'Library']. In the mobile menu @foreach array (line ~114), make the same replacement. These are the only two occurrences.

Modify resources/views/layouts/admin.blade.php. In the 'Content' nav-section, find the nav-item for Blog Posts (route admin.blog). Change: href to route('admin.library'), routeIs check to routeIs('admin.library*'), label text from 'Blog Posts' to 'Library', and update the SVG icon to a book icon (use: <path d='M2 3h6a4 4 0 0 1 4 4v14a3 3 0 0 0-3-3H2z'/><path d='M22 3h-6a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v14a3 3 0 0 1 3-3h7z'/> same as the Subjects icon).

Modify the four tutor sidebar files to add the 'Content' section. Files: resources/views/pages/tutor/group-sessions/index.blade.php, resources/views/pages/tutor/group-sessions/create.blade.php, resources/views/pages/tutor/group-sessions/show.blade.php, resources/views/pages/tutor-subjects/index.blade.php. In each file, inside the @if($isApproved) sidebar block, after the closing of the 'Group Classes' sb-section and before the opening
of the 'Examiner' sb-section, insert:
Content
My LibraryUpload Resource
acceptance_criteria: GET /library renders the library index page with filter bar, card grid, and sidebar
GET /library/{slug} renders a resource page; non-article type shows download card
GET /admin/library renders admin library with 'Library' label in sidebar
GET /tutor/library renders tutor library dashboard with 'My Library' active in sidebar
GET /tutor/library/create renders upload form with Alpine type-toggle hiding/showing content vs file input
Public nav shows 'Library' link instead of 'Blog' (desktop and mobile)
All four tutor sidebar views show 'Content' section with 'My Library' and 'Upload Resource'
